# Vendored libraries

| File | Library | Licence |
|------|---------|---------|
| `lame.min.js` | [lamejs](https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs) 1.2.1, a JavaScript port of [LAME](https://lame.sourceforge.io/) | LGPL-3.0 |

`lame.min.js` is unmodified and served as a separate file (`/lame.min.js`),
loaded by the web UI only to encode custom voice prompts to MP3 in the browser.
